episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. no one's put in the effort that you're doing when you just said that.

The more cacao we're sourcing, the more we're able to pay a living income reference price and then audit the farms and then get the kids into schools.
it's pretty interesting.

It went from over 500 kids in illegal child labor down to 50.

We're going to keep over time trying to get those 50 out of child labor.
But now imagine that.
If we can keep sourcing more cacao as we keep growing and we can keep getting more and more kids out of illegal child labor.
